pull_request.title: fix: fallback defaults for missing/empty config fields
pull_request.body:
## Summary

Extracts configuration parsing into a dedicated module with robust fallback defaults, fixing the ungraceful failure when  udget.toml is empty or missing required fields.

## Changes

- **New file:** \cargo-cost-lint/src/module_13.rs\
  - \BudgetConfig\ struct with \#[derive(Default)]\ and \#[serde(default)]\ so missing fields gracefully fall back to empty defaults
  - \parse_config(path)\ — reads a file and returns \BudgetConfig::default()\ on any error (missing file, empty content, invalid TOML, missing \[budget]\ table or \lints\ field)
  - \parse_config_str(raw)\ — same logic from a raw TOML string
  - \BudgetConfigWrapper\ handles the \[budget]\ table nesting
  - 11 test cases covering all edge cases: empty file, whitespace-only file, missing file, invalid TOML, empty/whitespace/invalid strings, missing \[budget]\ table, missing \lints\ field, and valid configs (both string and file)

- **Modified:** \cargo-cost-lint/src/main.rs\
  - Added \mod module_13;\
  - Removed inline \BudgetConfig\ struct and unused \serde::Deserialize\ import
  - Replaced nested \if-let\ config parsing with a single \module_13::parse_config()\ call

## Edge cases handled

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Config file does not exist | Returns empty defaults |
| Config file is empty | Returns empty defaults |
| Config file contains only whitespace | Returns empty defaults |
| Config file contains invalid TOML | Returns empty defaults |
| \[budget]\ table is missing | Returns empty defaults |
| \lints\ field is missing | Returns empty defaults |
| Valid config with lints | Parses correctly |

## Checks

- \cargo fmt --all -- --check\ passes
- \cargo clippy -p cargo-cost-lint -- -D warnings\ passes
- \cargo test\ cannot run in the dev environment (missing \dlltool.exe\), but all 11 unit tests are structurally correct

Closes #211
Closes #13
